annotation.title_clean: Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Commercialization of Autonomous Vehicles
annotation.title_en: Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Commercialization of Autonomous Vehicles
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Republic of Korea (President; Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport)
annotation.venue: Korea Legislation Research Institute (KLRI) Korean Law Translation Center
named_instruments_referenced: Compulsory Motor Vehicle Liability Security Act
annotation.summary_en: South Korea's Presidential Decree enforcing the Autonomous Vehicles Commercialization Act (amended Dec. 30, 2025). It sets rules for pilot operation zones, for-hire passenger and freight permits, mandatory insurance, cooperative autonomous driving certification, performance certification and conformity approval of autonomous vehicles, safety manager duties, and penalties.
key_provisions_or_claims: Procedures for designating, modifying and evaluating autonomous-vehicle pilot operation zones with regulatory exemptions
Mandatory insurance for pilot vehicles: 150M won per death, 1bn won property damage per accident
Performance certification (type confirmation and production inspection) and conformity approval for fully autonomous vehicles
Operators must designate safety managers, set emergency procedures, report accidents, protect event data recorders and prevent unauthorized access
Designation and supervision of cooperative autonomous driving certification and verification institutions, with penalty surcharges and fines
